land_pattern.package: SOD-123 - PACKAGE OUTLINE ONLY. This datasheet publishes NO recommended land pattern / suggested pad layout.
land_pattern.notes: NO LAND PATTERN IS PUBLISHED. Page 3 'PACKAGE OUTLINE - Plastic surface mounted package; 2 leads, SOD-123' gives only the package outline (top, side and end views with symbols A, bp, c, D, E, HE) and its min/max table; there is no pad drawing anywhere in the 3 pages. pitch_mm and pad_size_mm are therefore OMITTED rather than guessed - fp_verify will check pad_count and pin 1 only. OUTLINE TABLE (unit mm, max over min as printed): A 1.05 to 1.15 (height), b (= bp) 0.50 to 0.60 (lead width), c 0.100 to 0.135 (lead thickness), D 2.60 to 2.70 (body length), E 1.55 to 1.65 (body width), HE 3.55 to 3.85 (overall lead span, terminal tip to terminal tip), v 0.2, angle 5 degrees ALL ROUND. USEFUL CROSS-REFERENCES (not statements of this datasheet): the SMF15A on this same board is the same SOD-123 case and ITS datasheet does publish a land - 1.00 x 1.10 mm pads on 3.00 mm centres; KiCad 10.0 Diode_SMD:D_SOD-123 uses 0.9 x 1.2 mm pads on 3.30 mm centres. Either is a reasonable land for this outline; pick one deliberately and apply it consistently to both SOD-123 parts on the board.
